description: Curated JSON tools for formatting, validation, visualization, type generation, and schema-based validation.

tools.name: JSONLint
tools.pricing: Free to use; check the site's current terms.
tools.bestFor: Checking syntax and formatting small JSON documents.

tools.name: Prettier Playground
tools.bestFor: Formatting JSON and comparing formatter options.
limitations: Browser playground is not a substitute for local project configuration

tools.name: JSON Crack
tools.pricing: Freemium; features and limits may change.
tools.bestFor: Exploring nested JSON as a graph.
advantages: Makes large nested structures easier to inspect
limitations: Online input is sent to a third-party service
Review its privacy policy and current plan

tools.name: quicktype
tools.bestFor: Generating typed model definitions from representative JSON.
keyFeatures: Type generation for several programming languages
advantages: Helps bootstrap models from sample payloads
limitations: Sample data should not be confidential

tools.name: JSON Schema
tools.bestFor: Describing and validating the expected shape of JSON data.
keyFeatures: Links to validators for different languages
advantages: A portable way to document data constraints
limitations: A schema only validates rules that have been expressed
Implementation support can vary by draft
